spot_ema_moves_short_horizon.meaning: short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into the longer-horizon EMAs

twap_feeds_solvency_and_stale_gate.meaning: the TWAP returned by PanopticPool.getTWAP() is used in liquidation solvency checks and in the StaleOracle gate

spot_ema_weight_in_twap.meaning: weight (in percent) that short-horizon spotEMA movement receives in the returned TWAP

assumptions: The TWAP blend is the heavily smoothed (6 * fastEMA + 3 * slowEMA + eonsEMA) / 10 form, so spotEMA should carry 0% weight.
Short-horizon spotEMA movement is treated as a scenario condition that may hold before the computation.

unresolved.description: Report states short-horizon spotEMA propagation conditionally ('If') and does not establish it as an observed prior state; the precondition is encoded as a scenario condition.
Report gives the spotEMA weight as 10% (should be 0%) but no numeric definition of the EMA blend operands or their units for a full arithmetic relation.

limitations: Only the spotEMA-weight impact is formalized; StaleOracle gate flips, solvency misclassification, and liquidation harms are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
The 10% observed weight is not encoded as a precondition; it is the reported violation magnitude of the selected impact.
No caller/authorization condition is stated for twapEMA(), so none is encoded.
